title: Curator

designed to work alongside students, not do the work for them

ship it and get a luggage tag in the mail

title: DATAC pipeline
summary: a nextflow pipeline for demultiplexing ATAC and WGS reads from the DATAC single-cell co-assay. built during my summer internship in the Shah lab at Memorial Sloan Kettering (mskcc).
highlights: built for the DATAC single-cell co-assay
written during my summer internship at msk

title: Pioneer Scouting
summary: full rebuild of the scouting web app for the Pascack Pioneers (frc 1676). React and Express under the hood, with offline storage so it still works in a scouting stand with no signal, and a Google OAuth role system for pit scouts, drive teams, and leads.
highlights: offline-first: keeps working with no signal in the stands
google oauth roles for pit scouts, drive teams, and leads

title: Home server
summary: a home server running dokploy with traefik in front of docker containers. it hosts my robotics team's scouting app and a handful of side projects across a few domains, all on hardware and networks i manage myself.
highlights: dokploy for deploys, traefik for routing and certs
hosts the scouting app and side projects across a few domains
